sections.title: Brain (LLM)
sections.description: Which local language model answers you, and how it generates text. Models come from Ollama.

fields.label: Model selection
fields.help: auto picks fast/mid/heavy per message using the rules below. Or force one tier.

fields.label: Fast model
fields.help: Tiny model for quick chat. Must match a name from `ollama list`.

fields.label: Mid model
fields.help: Mid tier. On Ollama the tag `phi` is Phi-2 (2.7B).

fields.label: Heavy model
fields.help: Big brain. On Ollama `mistral` is Mistral 7B. Needs roughly 5-8 GB RAM/VRAM.

fields.label: Auto: words for mid tier
fields.help: In auto mode, messages longer than this many words go to the mid model.

fields.label: Auto: words for heavy tier
fields.help: In auto mode, messages longer than this go to the heavy model.

fields.label: Auto: keywords that force heavy
fields.help: Comma-separated. If the message contains one, auto mode uses the heavy model.

fields.label: Ollama address
fields.help: Where the Ollama server listens.

fields.label: Temperature
fields.help: Higher = more creative, lower = more focused.

fields.label: Top-p
fields.help: Nucleus sampling cutoff.

fields.label: Top-k
fields.help: Only sample from the k most likely tokens (0 = off).

fields.label: Repeat penalty
fields.help: Discourages repeating itself.

fields.label: Max reply tokens
fields.help: Hard cap on reply length. Shorter replies speak faster.

fields.label: Context window (tokens)
fields.help: How much conversation + files the model can see. Bigger uses more RAM.

fields.label: Seed (-1 = random)
fields.help: Fixed seed makes replies repeatable.

fields.label: Keep model loaded
fields.help: How long Ollama keeps the model in memory after use (e.g. 5m, 1h, -1 = forever).

fields.label: Request timeout (s)
fields.help: Give up on the model after this long.

fields.label: Memory (past turns sent)
fields.help: How many previous user/assistant pairs are sent with each message.

fields.label: Stop sequences
fields.help: Comma-separated strings that end generation.

fields.label: Warm up model at start
fields.help: Loads the model into memory in the background so the first reply is fast.

fields.label: Assistant name
fields.help: Substituted for {name} in the system prompt.

fields.label: System prompt
fields.default: You are {name}, a local assistant that lives inside a glass crystal ball on the user's desktop. Everything you write is read aloud, so answer in short, natural spoken sentences. Do not use markdown, bullet points, emojis, or code blocks unless the user explicitly asks for code. If you do not know something, say so plainly instead of guessing.
fields.help: The base instructions. {name} is replaced by the assistant name.

sections.title: Voice (TTS)
sections.description: Every reply is spoken aloud. The voice model is separate from the brain.

fields.label: Speak replies
fields.help: Master switch for spoken output.

fields.label: Voice engine
fields.help: phonon = local Gradium Phonon model. system = your OS voices (instant, robotic). off = silent.

fields.label: Phonon model id
fields.help: Hugging Face model id. Gated + CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial).

fields.label: Compute device
fields.help: Where Phonon runs.

fields.label: Speech speed
fields.help: Implemented by resampling, so it also shifts pitch.

fields.label: Volume
fields.help: Playback gain in the ball window.

fields.label: Output sample rate
fields.help: Sample rate of Phonon audio. Change only if the voice sounds too fast/slow.

fields.label: Speak while thinking
fields.help: Starts speaking the first sentence while the brain is still writing the rest.

fields.label: Max characters per spoken chunk
fields.help: Long sentences are split to keep latency low.

fields.label: Strip markdown before speaking
fields.help: Removes asterisks, headings, links, etc.

fields.label: Skip code blocks when speaking
fields.help: Replaces code with 'code omitted' in speech (still shown in the box).

fields.label: Speak tool activity
fields.help: Say things like 'reading file' aloud when the agent uses tools.

fields.label: Stop speaking on new message
fields.help: Sending a new query cuts off current speech.

fields.label: Preload voice model at start
fields.help: Loads Phonon at launch (slower start, instant first reply).

fields.label: System voice name
fields.help: For engine=system. Blank = OS default. Exact voice name from the OS.

fields.label: Hugging Face token
fields.help: Needed once for gated models. Stored in plain text in settings.json.

sections.title: Crystal ball
sections.description: The glass itself. Everything here applies live.

fields.label: Ball diameter
fields.help: Size in pixels.

fields.label: Refraction strength
fields.help: How hard the glass bends what is behind it.

fields.label: Magnification
fields.help: Lens zoom at the center.

fields.label: Index of refraction
fields.help: Glass = 1.5, water = 1.33, diamond = 2.4.

fields.label: Chromatic aberration
fields.help: Rainbow fringing at the edges.

fields.label: Blur
fields.help: Base blur of the view through the ball.

fields.label: Edge frost
fields.help: Extra blur toward the rim.

fields.label: Glass tint
fields.help: Color cast of the glass.

fields.label: Darken background
fields.help: Dims the scene behind the glass. Raise it if the ball looks washed out.

fields.label: Edge darkening
fields.help: Darker glass edge, like a real glass ball. Gives the highlights contrast so the ball does not look white.

fields.label: Rim light
fields.help: Fresnel glow around the edge.

fields.label: Specular highlight
fields.help: The bright reflection of a window light.

fields.label: Caustic crescent
fields.help: Focused light on the far side of the glass.

fields.label: Wobble / liquid motion
fields.help: How much the glass ripples when thinking or speaking.

fields.label: Accent color
fields.help: Used for glow while listening, thinking and speaking.

fields.label: Outer aura
fields.help: Halo around the ball when active.

fields.label: Idle frame rate
fields.help: Render rate when nothing is happening.

fields.label: Active frame rate
fields.help: Render rate while thinking/speaking/dragging.

sections.title: Dialogue box
sections.description: The borderless box under the ball.

fields.label: Font family
fields.default: "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif

fields.label: Background darkness
fields.help: How dark the frosted panel is.

fields.label: Backdrop blur
fields.help: Frosting of the desktop behind the box.

fields.label: Stream text as it is written
fields.help: Off = show the whole reply at once.

fields.label: Auto-hide after reply (0 = never)
fields.help: Hides the box this many seconds after speech finishes.

sections.title: Behavior & window
sections.description: How the app lives on your desktop.

fields.label: Global hotkey
fields.help: Shows the ball and toggles the dialogue box from anywhere.

fields.label: Show in taskbar
fields.help: Off = tray icon only.

fields.label: Start with system
fields.help: Launch at login.

fields.label: Start hidden
fields.help: Starts in the tray; use the hotkey to show.

fields.label: Click-through transparent areas
fields.help: Lets clicks pass through empty parts of the window. Not supported on Linux.

fields.label: Refract the real desktop
fields.help: Captures the screen behind the ball for the glass effect. Needs screen-capture permission on macOS.

fields.label: Hide ball from screen capture
fields.help: Required for refraction (otherwise the ball sees itself). Not supported on Linux.

fields.label: Capture frame rate
fields.help: How often the desktop is sampled.

fields.label: Capture max width
fields.help: Lower = lighter on the GPU.

fields.label: Quit only from tray menu
fields.help: Closing windows never quits the app; use tray → Quit.

sections.title: Agent & folder access
sections.description: Lets the model read and (optionally) change files in one folder you choose.

fields.label: Enable file tools
fields.help: If off, the assistant is chat-only.

fields.label: Workspace folder
fields.help: The ONLY folder the agent can touch. Nothing outside it is reachable.

fields.label: Allow reading
fields.help: list_dir, read_file, search_files, grep.

fields.label: Allow writing
fields.help: write_file, make_dir.

fields.label: Allow deleting
fields.help: delete_path (moves nothing to trash — permanent).

fields.label: Allow running commands
fields.help: run_command: runs ONE program with arguments inside the workspace folder. No shell, so no pipes or &&. Off by default.

fields.label: Ask before running a command
fields.help: Shows the exact command with Allow/Deny. Keep this on: the allow-list below is a speed bump, NOT a sandbox (git, python, npm can all run arbitrary code).

fields.label: Command policy
fields.help: allowlist = only the programs listed below. any = anything except the deny list.

fields.label: Allowed commands
fields.help: Comma-separated program names. Adding python/node/pip/npm lets the model run arbitrary code, so only add them if you accept that.

fields.label: Blocked commands
fields.help: Never run, even in 'any' mode.

fields.label: Command timeout
fields.help: Commands running longer are stopped.

fields.label: Max command output returned
fields.help: Longer output is cut.

fields.label: Allow network access
fields.help: Lets skills like fetch_url read web pages. Local/private addresses stay blocked.

fields.label: Ask before network access
fields.help: Web pages can contain text that tries to give the model orders; confirmation keeps you in the loop.

fields.label: Load plugin skills
fields.help: Tools from backend/skills/*.py. Reload them from Tools & diagnostics.

fields.label: Disabled skills
fields.help: Comma-separated tool names to switch off (e.g. get_time,system_info).

fields.label: Ask before write/delete
fields.help: Shows Allow/Deny buttons in the dialogue box. Strongly recommended.

fields.label: Max tokens when tools are on
fields.help: Writing a file puts its whole content inside the tool call, so this must be bigger than a normal reply. If file writes get cut off, raise it.

fields.label: Max tool steps per message
fields.help: Stops runaway loops.

fields.label: Max characters returned per read
fields.help: Larger files are truncated.

fields.label: Ignored names
fields.help: Comma-separated file/folder names hidden from the agent.

fields.label: Allowed extensions
fields.help: Comma-separated like .txt,.md,.py. Blank = all text-like files.

fields.label: Follow symlinks
fields.help: Off = links pointing outside the folder are blocked.

fields.label: Extra agent instructions
fields.help: Appended to the tool instructions (project conventions, etc.).

sections.title: Backend process
sections.description: The Python server. Most of these need a backend restart.

fields.label: Python executable
fields.help: Blank = auto-detect (backend/.venv first).

fields.label: Startup timeout (s)
fields.help: First start can be slow while Python imports torch.

fields.label: Data folder override
fields.help: Where chat_history.db lives. Blank = app data folder.

sections.title: Debug (temporary)
sections.description: Verbose visibility while you develop. Turn these off later.

fields.label: Open debug console at start
fields.help: Shows every log line and error from every process.

fields.label: Console log level
fields.help: Minimum level shown/recorded.

fields.label: Red error badge on the ball
fields.help: A small dot appears on the ball when something errors.

fields.label: Log full prompts and replies
fields.help: Writes exactly what is sent to / received from the model.

fields.label: Show model + timing under replies
fields.help: Tiny grey line like 'phi · 2.4s'.

fields.label: Open DevTools for the ball
fields.help: Detached Chromium DevTools.
